title: Attack On Titan Backpack Anime Cosplay AOT
categoryName: Collectibles:Animation Art & Merchandise:Animation Merchandise:Other Animation Merchandise
descriptionText: This is an Attack on Titan backpack designed for anime cosplay. The backpack features a brown color scheme and is inspired by the Titans from the Attack on Titan franchise. Perfect for fans of the popular anime series, this collectible item is a unique piece of animation merchandise that allows you to show your love for the show while carrying your essentials in style.
